options.description: Use the same independent Service URL. WebSocket needs a supported server-side n8n host and has no replay or automatic HTTP fallback.

properties.description: ISO language or supported locale. Leave empty for API detection. Roman Urdu requires ur.

properties.name: binaryProperty
properties.description: The binary field for the generated audio

properties.description: Simultaneous item requests in this execution. Configurable without an upper ceiling; the API remains the capacity authority.

options.name: idempotencyKey
options.description: HTTP Generate only. WebSocket does not support idempotent replay. Stable business job key for HTTP replay across workflow reruns.

options.name: requestTimeoutMs
options.description: HTTP request or complete WebSocket session timeout in milliseconds. Zero disables it. No coded upper ceiling.
